remarks: This 5-bedroom, 2-bath Colonial offers over 2,000 sq ft of flexible living space designed for comfort and convenience. The first floor features an inviting eat-in kitchen that opens to a large deck-ideal for gatherings and outdoor dining. A bright living room, dining area, two bedrooms, and a full bath complete this level, offering a practical layout for everyday living. Upstairs, you'll find a second kitchen, living room, and two additional bedrooms-perfect for extended family, in-laws, or guests who prefer their own space. The finished lower level includes a laundry area, another bedroom, and direct access to the one-car garage. Conveniently located near schools, shopping, and major routes, this home offers space, versatility, and an excellent location.
